trial_court: Court of Sh. Snehil Sharma, Judicial Magistrate First Class NI Act, Patiala House Court, New Delhi (CC No: 17880/2019)
case_name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd vs K. Dhanalakshmi
facts_of_case: Complainant advanced working capital limits to M/s Ultra Tile Pvt. Ltd. and the borrower committed default in repayment of credit facilities. Despite repeated requests, the borrower failed to repay the dues.

legal_principles.principle: The liability of the guarantor starts from day 1.
legal_principles.held: The liability of the guarantor start from day 1 and the bank initiates the action again the borrower and thereafter again the guarantor.

legal_principles.principle: No action under SARFAESI Act can be taken within the 60-day time frame.
legal_principles.held: It is mandatory to give 60 days notice under sarfaesi act by the complainant to the borrower and guarantor. It is correctly admitted that no action under sarfaesi act can be taken within the aforesaid time frame.

outcome.result: Accused Ms. K. Dhanalakshmi is convicted for offences punishable under sections 138 NI Act.
outcome.final_order: The accused is convicted and held guilty of the offence punishable under sections 138 NI Act.
